substrate_boundary: software file/state replication over host filesystem; no physical disk or hardware RAID authority
state_class: file-backed mirrored state plus deterministic manifest
persistence_class: filesystem atomic replace + fsync + persisted mirror manifest
address_space: filesystem-relative path namespace inside source/mirror roots

interfaces.name: mirror_update
interfaces.contract: source root -> deterministic manifest -> verified mirror receipt

interfaces.name: mirror_restore
interfaces.contract: verified mirror -> restored state -> parity receipt

interfaces.name: braink_transfer_adapter
interfaces.contract: cross-repository subprocess/receipt contract; mirror semantics remain cloud-owned

proof_conditions: post-update mirror manifest digest equals source manifest digest
corrupted mirror is rejected before restore
post-restore destination manifest digest equals verified mirror manifest digest
downstream cross-repository consumer verifies its own state/identity invariants
rollback_requirements: failed update/restore must not be promoted
downstream consumer must retain prior authoritative state until restored state passes its own readback
cross-host carrier failure must be classified separately from mirror-runtime failure

required_capabilities: durable directory flush or documented platform substitute
platform_specific_adapters: Windows durable-write/replace adapter required before Windows qualification

operators: BRAINK qualification workflows as bounded consumer

invalid_claims: software mirror runtime is not physical RAID
single-host restore is not cross-machine migration proof
workflow queued state is not execution evidence
BRAINK consumer adapter does not own mirror-lane semantics
